name: Budgerigar
description: Small and social bird that enjoys interaction and can learn simple words.
info: The Budgerigar is a friendly, social, and intelligent bird that enjoys interaction and mental stimulation. name: Cockatiel

info: The Cockatiel is a gentle, affectionate, and social bird that enjoys interacting with people and learning simple tricks. name: Lovebird
description: Active and curious bird that forms strong bonds with its owner.
info: The Lovebird is a playful, affectionate, and highly social bird that thrives on companionship. These birds should not be kept alone, as they can become lonely, stressed, or develop behavioral problems without regular interaction from another lovebird or their owner. They are generally healthy but may be prone to respiratory infections and feather-plucking if stressed. Their feathers require minimal grooming, but they need a spacious cage, fresh water, and daily opportunities to fly and play.

name: African Grey Parrot
description: Highly intelligent bird that requires mental stimulation and close interaction.
info: The African Grey Parrot is an intelligent, loyal, and highly social bird that forms strong bonds with its owner. It needs daily interaction and mental stimulation, as boredom can lead to stress and feather-plucking. Due to its sensitive nature, it is usually not the best choice for families with young children or noisy households. This species is generally healthy but may be prone to calcium deficiency and respiratory infections, so a balanced diet and regular veterinary check-ups are important. Their feathers require minimal grooming, but they need a spacious cage and daily time outside the cage for exercise.

name: Sun Conure
